title: 第10章  极阴之体，麻雀变凤凰
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
“终于没事了。”
房间里，李寒山松了一口气。
随着阴寒之气被吸出，许灵溪慢慢恢复了正常。她的脸色不再惨白，嘴唇也恢复了血色，身上的寒霜尽数消融。
李寒山低头一看，她早已沉沉睡去。他抱着她，心中翻腾不已。
因为他发现自己拥有了神识。他不需要睁眼，便能“看见”房间的每一个角落，连床底有几只蚂蚁在爬来爬去都清清楚楚。
“她体内那股极寒之气到底是什么，怎么有这么好的效果？”
李寒山低头看着熟睡中的许灵溪，暗自思索。
这次他可谓是赚翻了，修为直上炼气四层，这要是被人知道，得羡慕死。这真是烧香摸到菩萨脚，误打误撞得了好。本不为回报，回报却不期而至。
眼看夜色已深，他将许灵溪放在床上，为她盖上被子，接着自己盘腿坐在一旁，巩固起来。
第二天许灵溪早早醒来。
李寒山察觉到动静，睁眼问道：“灵溪，你现在感觉怎么样？”
许灵溪点头，俏脸微红：“李爷爷，我很好，昨晚多亏了你！”
“那就好。”
李寒山掏出一个玉瓶，倒出一枚丹药递给她：“这是聚气丹，应该可以帮你。”
许灵溪看到丹药，眼睛一亮，随即连连摆手：“李爷爷，这，这可是宝丹啊，太珍贵了，我不能要！”
对候选弟子来说，聚气丹确实珍贵无比，他们全部身家都买不起一粒。
李寒山强行将聚气丹塞到了她的手里：“拿着！活下来，以后再报答我不迟！”
许灵溪攥着那粒丹药，手心沉甸甸的，仿佛托着一座山。她眼眶一热，泪水在打转，却咬着唇硬生生憋了回去。
“嗯！”
重重点头后，她将聚气丹吞下，闭上眼睛，专注的修炼起来。

这一修炼，就是整整两天。
两天后。
许灵溪猛地睁开眼，眼中精光一闪而过。
“李爷爷！我突破炼气了！”
她雀跃地跳起来，像个小孩子一样又蹦又跳，脸上的喜悦怎么都藏不住。
“这么快？”
李寒山吃了一惊。
他的修炼速度快，是因为有花弄影这个炼气大圆满的妖女给他吸。可许灵溪才刚开脉，仅凭一枚聚气丹，两天就突破炼气，这速度也太离谱了。
她难不成还是个绝世天才？
“李爷爷，谢谢你！”
许灵溪激动得扑进李寒山怀里，眼泪又流了下来，但这次是喜极而泣。
“好了好了，都炼气了，还哭鼻子。”
李寒山拍拍她的后背，笑道。
第二天一早。
候选弟子考核的日子到了。
空地上，数十名候选弟子三三两两地聚在一起，有的神情紧张，有的胸有成竹。
许灵溪刚一走出，便被一名候选弟子出言讥讽。
“哟？小妹妹，你不是挺清高吗，怎么也忍不住找炉鼎了？”
这弟子叫杨雪，本是一风尘女子，在入宗当天，就毫无心理障碍的租了个炉鼎。她由此成为最快突破炼气的那一批弟子，身边还聚集了几个候选弟子，当起了大姐大。
许灵溪不与对方争辩，默默来到人群中站定。

杨雪见她不搭理，冷哼一声，却也不敢过于挑衅。
而在不远处，聚集着不少男修，他们对着众多候选弟子指指点点，仿佛在挑选即将出售的货物一般。那个被李寒山扇了一巴掌的孙泽，赫然在其中。
这时，一道遁光从天际划过，落在空地上方。
来人足有三个，两男一女，为首的是个中年男子，身穿青衣长袍，周身气息深不可测，目光睥睨地扫过众人。
他是合欢宗的外门执事，专门负责外门弟子的考核，资源发放等等琐事。
“都给我安静！”
中年执事冷喝一声，声音不大，却如惊雷般在每个人耳边炸响。
候选弟子们噤若寒蝉，再不敢出声。
“我叫赵元，负责本次考核。”中年执事淡淡道，“考核很简单，释放你们的灵力波动，让我看看修为即可。”
候选弟子们依次上前，释放灵力波动接受检测。
至于那些灵力波动释放不出来的，便是连炼气都没突破，等待她们的将是沦为炉鼎的命运。
轮到杨雪时，她得意扬扬地释放出灵力波动。
“通过。”
赵元淡淡道。
杨雪喜形于色，挺着胸脯站到了一旁。
终于，轮到许灵溪了。
她深吸一口气，走上前去，释放出自己的灵力。
“通过。”
赵元的声音一如既往的平淡。
话音一落，孙泽跟杨雪的目光同时凝固。特别是孙泽，这家伙满脸的不可置信：“怎么可能！”

在他看来，不租炉鼎许灵溪绝对突破不了炼气，他等在这里，就是为了待会儿买下许灵溪，带回去好好折磨一番，以报被李寒山打了一巴掌之恨。
哪知许灵溪突破了！他的算盘落了空。
许灵溪自然没有留意他们，她心中一松，准备走到一旁。
“等等！”
赵元察觉到什么，原本漫不经心的表情突然凝固，死死盯着许灵溪，眼中爆发出精光：“极阴之体！居然是极阴之体！”
他的呼吸急促起来，目光变得贪婪。
“好！好！好！”
赵元连说三个好字，大步走到许灵溪面前，伸手就要去抓她的手腕：“小丫头，你这样的体质，留在外门太屈才了。跟我走，我亲自教你修炼，保你一年内筑基！”
许灵溪吓了一跳，连忙后退一步：“执事大人，我......”
“怎么？不愿意？”
赵元脸色一沉：“你知道极阴之体有多珍贵吗？落在别人手里，只会被当成炉鼎吸干。跟着我，我不仅能保护你，还能让你成为人上人！”
他说着，又要去抓许灵溪。
“什么，极阴之体？”
房间里，一直从窗缝关注着外面的李寒山大惊，眼看赵元要抓住许灵溪，他夺门而出。
“住手！”
李寒山冲出来，高声道：“前辈这样带走她，不合规矩吧？”
赵元一愣，随即皱眉：“你是什么东西？”
“哈哈哈，老东西，你这是找死。”
孙泽大喜，连忙跳出来，指着李寒山骂道：“你一个破炉鼎，竟敢管赵前辈的事？”
“什么？炉鼎？”

赵元气笑了，手指一弹，一道劲风射出，直接将李寒山震飞出去。
“砰！”
李寒山重重摔在地上，胸口剧痛，一口鲜血涌上喉咙。
“李爷爷！”
许灵溪惊叫一声，想要跑过去，却被赵元一把抓住。
“小丫头，别不识抬举。”赵元冷冷道，“我这是在救你。”
“放开她！”
李寒山挣扎着爬起来，死死盯着赵元：“她是候选弟子，按宗门规矩，考核通过后就是外门弟子。你凭什么强抢？”
“规矩？”
赵元仿佛听到了天大的笑话：“在这合欢宗，实力就是规矩！我就算强抢，谁敢说半个不字？”
他目光一寒，抬手打出一道术法：“老家伙，
李寒山脸色一变，往旁边躲去，奈何实力差距太大，这道攻击他避不开！
“住手！”
一道清洌的女声在众人耳边炸响。
紧接着，一道剑光从天而降，将赵元的攻击粉碎。
赵元脸色大变，猛地抬头。
半空中，一个绿衣女子凌空而立，周身剑气纵横，宛如九天仙子下凡。
“江......江长老！”
赵元的声音都在发抖。
“赵元，你好大的胆子。”

绿衣女子冷冷开口：“宗门考核，是你能肆意妄为的地方？”
“江长老，我......我只是......”
赵元额头冷汗直冒，想要解释，却发现自己在对方那恐怖到极点的威压面前，根本说不出完整的句子。
“滚！”
江念微只吐出一个字。
“是是是，小的先去考核男弟子。”
赵元如蒙大赦，连滚带爬地逃走了。
绿衣女子从空中落下，目光在许灵溪身上停留片刻，眼中闪过一丝讶异。
“极阴之体，确实难得。”
她转向许灵溪，语气柔和了几分：“小丫头，你可愿拜我为师？”
许灵溪愣住了，呆呆地看着眼前这位一袭绿衣、若竹似翡的女修。
李寒山同样有些发愣。这转折来得太快，让他有些反应不过来。
“我是合欢宗长老江念微，掌管碧玉峰，金丹修士。”
绿衣女子淡淡道：“拜我为师，从今往后，没人敢欺负你。”
这两个字一出，在场所有人都骚动起来，窃窃私语声四起。
不管是候选还是外门弟子，看向许灵溪的目光，都充满了浓到极点的羡慕！
他们连拜师筑基都难，许灵溪却能直接拜师金丹！
“该死，为什么她的命这么好？”杨雪嫉妒得快要发狂。
“完了，我完了。”孙泽脸色惨白，快要瘫软在地。
在所有人的目光中，许灵溪却下意识地看向李寒山。

李寒山对她点了点头。
“弟子许灵溪，拜见师父！”
许灵溪跪下行礼，声音带着激动。
或许是许灵溪的动作，让江念微目光转向李寒山，在他身上停留两秒后，淡淡道：“纯阳之体...可惜了。”
跪着的许灵溪又看了李寒山一眼，像是下了什么决心似的，再次开口：“师父，徒弟有个请求......”
江念微打断她，目光如炬：“你想帮他？”
许灵溪点头：“是，师父，希望可以免去李爷爷炉鼎身份，放他一条生路。”
她的话，让李寒山心中一热，这小姑娘心地一如既往的善良，不枉他这几天费尽心机地帮她。
“我可帮不了他。”
江念微的话，让许灵溪心中一沉，但旋即她话音一转：“罢了，念他刚才挺身而出，胆识有加，这张符送他，可挡筑基一击。”
言罢，她弹出一张灵符，落在李寒山手里。接着便抓起许灵溪便冲天而起，化作流光，眨眼之间消失在天际。
“她这是麻雀变凤凰了啊。”
李寒山捏着灵符，仰头看着流光消失，既羡慕，又为许灵溪感到开心。
content_en:
"It's finally okay."
In the room, Li Hanshan breathed a sigh of relief.
As the cold air was sucked out, Xu Lingxi slowly returned to normal. Her face was no longer pale, her lips had regained their color, and all the frost on her body had melted away.
Li Hanshan looked down and saw that she had already fallen asleep. He held her, his heart churning.
Because he discovered that he had divine consciousness. He could "see" every corner of the room without opening his eyes. He could even clearly see a few ants crawling under the bed.
"What is that extremely cold air in her body, and how can it have such a good effect?"
Li Hanshan looked down at the sleeping Xu Lingxi and thought to himself.
This time he has made a lot of money, and his cultivation has reached the fourth level of Qi Refining. If anyone knew about this, they would be envious to death. This is really the best thing to do if you burn incense and touch the Bodhisattva's feet by accident. There was no reward, but the reward came unexpectedly.
Seeing that the night was getting dark, he put Xu Lingxi on the bed, covered her with a quilt, and then sat cross-legged beside her to consolidate herself.
Xu Lingxi woke up early the next day.
Li Hanshan noticed the movement, opened his eyes and asked, "Lingxi, how do you feel now?"
Xu Lingxi nodded, her pretty face blushing slightly: "Grandpa Li, I'm fine, thanks to you last night!"
"That's good."
Li Hanshan took out a jade bottle, poured out a pill and handed it to her: "This is the Qi Gathering Pill, it should be able to help you."
Xu Lingxi's eyes lit up when she saw the elixir, and she waved her hands repeatedly: "Grandpa Li, this, this is a treasure elixir. It's too precious. I can't have it!"
For the candidate disciples, the Qi Gathering Pill is indeed extremely precious, and their entire wealth cannot afford to buy even one.
Li Hanshan forced the Qi Gathering Pill into her hand: "Take it! If you survive, it won't be too late to repay me later!"
Xu Lingxi held the pill in her hands, as if she were holding a mountain in her hands. Her eyes were hot and tears were welling up in her eyes, but she bit her lip and held it back.
"Yeah!"
After nodding heavily, she swallowed the Qi Gathering Pill, closed her eyes, and concentrated on practicing.
This practice lasted for two full days.
Two days later.
Xu Lingxi opened his eyes suddenly, and a light flashed in his eyes.
"Grandpa Li! I have achieved a breakthrough in Qi refining!"
She jumped up happily, jumping up and down like a child, the joy on her face could not be hidden.
"So fast?"
Li Hanshan was surprised.
The reason why he cultivates so fast is because he has Hua Nongying, a witch with a perfect Qi practice, to suck him. But Xu Lingxi had just opened his pulse, and with just one Qi Gathering Pill, he was able to break through Qi Refining in two days. This speed was too outrageous.
Could it be that she is still a genius?
"Grandpa Li, thank you!"
Xu Lingxi was so excited that she threw herself into Li Hanshan's arms and shed tears again, but this time she cried with joy.
"Okay, okay, I've refined my energy, and I'm still crying."
Li Hanshan patted her back and smiled.
Early the next morning.
The day for the candidate disciple assessment has arrived.
In the open space, dozens of candidate disciples gathered together in twos and threes, some looked nervous, and some were confident.
As soon as Xu Lingxi walked out, he was ridiculed by a candidate disciple.
"Hey? Little sister, aren't you quite noble? Why can't you help yourself to find the furnace?"
This disciple's name is Yang Xue. She is a prostitute. On the day she joined the sect, she rented a furnace without any psychological barriers. As a result, she became one of the disciples who broke through Qi refining the fastest, and she also gathered several candidate disciples around her, becoming the eldest sister.
Xu Lingxi did not argue with the other party and silently came to stand in the crowd.
Seeing that she was ignoring her, Yang Xue snorted coldly, but did not dare to be too provocative.
Not far away, many male cultivators gathered. They pointed at the many candidate disciples, as if they were selecting goods to be sold. Sun Ze, who was slapped by Li Hanshan, was among them.
At this time, a ray of light flashed across the sky and landed above the open space.
There were three people coming, two men and one woman, the leaderThe one in front of him was a middle-aged man, wearing a green robe, with an unfathomable aura around him, and he glanced at everyone with a stern look.
He is the outer deacon of Hehuan Sect, responsible for the assessment of outer disciples, distribution of resources and other trivial matters.
"Quiet, everyone!"
The middle-aged deacon shouted coldly, his voice was not loud, but it sounded like thunder in everyone's ears.
The candidate disciples remained silent and did not dare to speak out again.
"My name is Zhao Yuan, and I am in charge of this assessment." The middle-aged deacon said calmly, "The assessment is very simple. Just release your spiritual power fluctuations and let me see your cultivation."
The candidate disciples stepped forward one by one and released spiritual power fluctuations for testing.
As for those whose spiritual power fluctuations cannot be released, they have not even broken through in refining their Qi. What awaits them is the fate of being reduced to a furnace.
When it was Yang Xue's turn, she proudly released her spiritual power fluctuations.
"Passed."
Zhao Yuan said calmly.
Yang Xue beamed with joy and stood aside with her chest puffed out.
Finally, it was Xu Lingxi's turn.
She took a deep breath, stepped forward, and released her spiritual power.
"Passed."
Zhao Yuan's voice was as calm as ever.
As soon as he finished speaking, Sun Ze and Yang Xue's eyes froze at the same time. Especially Sun Ze, this guy's face was full of disbelief: "How is that possible!"
In his opinion, Xu Lingxi would never be able to break through Qi refining without renting a furnace. He was waiting here just to buy Xu Lingxi later and take him back to torture him in retaliation for being slapped by Li Hanshan.
Unexpectedly, Xu Lingxi made a breakthrough! His calculation failed.
Xu Lingxi naturally didn't pay attention to them. She felt relieved and prepared to walk aside.
"Wait!"
Zhao Yuan noticed something, and his originally careless expression suddenly froze. He stared at Xu Lingxi, his eyes bursting with light: "Extreme Yin body! It's actually an extremely Yin body!"
His breathing quickened and his eyes became greedy.
"Okay! Okay! Okay!"
Zhao Yuan said three good words in a row, strode up to Xu Lingxi, and reached out to grab her wrist: "Little girl, with your physique, it would be too unqualified to stay in the outer sect. Come with me, I will personally teach you how to practice, and I will ensure that you build a foundation within a year!"
Xu Lingxi was startled and quickly took a step back: "Master Deacon, I..."
"What? Don't want to?"
Zhao Yuan's face darkened: "Do you know how precious the extremely yin body is? If it falls into the hands of others, it will only be sucked dry. Follow me, and I will not only protect you, but also make you a master!"
He said, going to catch Xu Lingxi again.
"What, extremely yin body?"
In the room, Li Hanshan, who had been watching the outside through the crack of the window, was shocked. Seeing that Zhao Yuan was about to catch Xu Lingxi, he rushed out of the door.
"Stop!"
Li Hanshan rushed out and said loudly: "Senior, is it against the rules to take her away like this?"
Zhao Yuan was stunned for a moment, then frowned: "Who are you?"
"Hahaha, old man, you are looking for death."
Sun Ze was overjoyed and jumped out quickly, pointed at Li Hanshan and cursed: "How dare you interfere with Senior Zhao's affairs, even though you are a broken man?"
"What? Furnace?"
Zhao Yuanqi smiled, flicked his fingers, and a strong wind shot out, directly knocking Li Hanshan away.
"Bang!"
Li Hanshan fell heavily to the ground, feeling severe pain in his chest and a mouthful of blood rushing to his throat.
"Grandpa Li!"
Xu Lingxi screamed and wanted to run over, but was caught by Zhao Yuan.
"Little girl, don't be disrespectful." Zhao Yuan said coldly, "I am saving you."
"Let her go!"
Li Hanshan struggled to get up and stared at Zhao Yuan: "She is a candidate disciple. According to the sect's rules, after passing the examination, she will become an outer disciple. Why do you rob her?"
"Rules?"
Zhao Yuan seemed to have heard a huge joke: "In this Hehuan Sect, strength is the rule! Even if I rob, who dares to say no?"
His eyes turned cold, and he raised his hand to cast a spell: "Old guy,
Li Hanshan's expression changed and he hid aside.The power gap is too big, he can't avoid this attack!
"Stop!"
A clear female voice rang in everyone's ears.
Immediately afterwards, a sword light fell from the sky, shattering Zhao Yuan's attack.
Zhao Yuan's expression changed drastically and he raised his head suddenly.
In mid-air, a woman in green clothes stood in the air, with sword energy flowing all over her body, like a fairy descending from the Nine Heavens.
"Jiang...Elder Jiang!"
Zhao Yuan's voice was trembling.
"Zhao Yuan, you are so brave."
The woman in green said coldly: "The sect assessment is a place where you can do whatever you want?"
"Elder Jiang, I...I just..."
Cold sweat broke out on Zhao Yuan's forehead. He wanted to explain, but found that he could not speak a complete sentence in the face of the other party's extremely terrifying pressure.
"Get out!"
Jiang Nianwei only uttered one word.
"Yes, yes, the younger one will assess the male disciples first."
Zhao Yuan was granted amnesty and ran away crawling on the ground.
The woman in green clothes fell from the sky, her eyes lingered on Xu Lingxi for a moment, and a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes.
"It is indeed rare to have an extremely yin body."
She turned to Xu Lingxi and her tone was a little softer: "Little girl, are you willing to become my teacher?"
Xu Lingxi was stunned, staring blankly at the female cultivator in front of her who was dressed in green and looked like bamboo.
Li Hanshan was also in a daze. This turn of events happened so quickly that he couldn't react.
"I am Jiang Nianwei, the elder of Hehuan Sect, in charge of Jasper Peak and a golden elixir monk."
The woman in green clothes said calmly: "Accept me as your teacher. From now on, no one will dare to bully you."
As soon as these two words came out, everyone present became commotion, and whispers broke out.
Whether he was a candidate or an outer disciple, the eyes he looked at Xu Lingxi were filled with extreme envy!
It was difficult for them to even become a disciple to build a foundation, but Xu Lingxi was able to directly become an apprentice to Jin Dan!
"Damn it, why is her life so good?" Yang Xue was almost going crazy with jealousy.
"It's done, I'm done." Sun Ze's face turned pale and he was about to collapse to the ground.
Under everyone's gaze, Xu Lingxi subconsciously looked at Li Hanshan.
Li Hanshan nodded to her.
"Disciple Xu Lingxi, pay homage to Master!"
Xu Lingxi knelt down and saluted, her voice filled with excitement.
Perhaps it was Xu Lingxi's actions that made Jiang Nianwei turn his eyes to Li Hanshan. After staying on him for two seconds, he said lightly: "Pure Yang body... What a pity."
Xu Lingxi, who was kneeling, glanced at Li Hanshan again, as if he had made up his mind, and spoke again: "Master, apprentice has a request..."
Jiang Nianwei interrupted her, his eyes blazing: "You want to help him?"
Xu Lingxi nodded: "Yes, Master, I hope that Grandpa Li can be removed from his furnace status and let him live."
Her words made Li Hanshan's heart heat up. This little girl was as kind-hearted as ever, and it was worth his efforts to help her these days.
"I can't help him."
Jiang Nianwei's words made Xu Lingxi's heart sink, but then she changed her voice: "That's all, I think he stepped forward just now and was very courageous. This talisman given to him can block the attack of foundation building."

Li Hanshan held the magic talisman and looked up at the streamer disappearing. He was envious and happy for Xu Lingxi.
